name: Datum Cloud Agent Skills
description: Agent skills for signing in to Datum Cloud, running datumctl and datum-mcp from CI, and handing questions to Patch, Datum's own assistant

installation.claude-code: claude plugin marketplace add datum-cloud/skills && claude plugin install datum-cloud@datum-cloud

skills.name: sign-in
skills.description: Get signed in to Datum Cloud with datumctl and datum-mcp, and pointed at the right organization and project

skills.name: ci-service-account
skills.description: Set up a Datum Cloud service account so CI or a headless agent can run datumctl or datum-mcp without a person signing in

skills.name: datum-cloud-assistant
skills.description: Know when to hand a Datum Cloud task to Patch, datumctl's AI assistant plugin, instead of using datum-mcp's resource tools directly
